question: Which constructors have won the most races since 2014? Also show how wins per season evolved for the top 3.

- Mercedes' peak years were 2014-2020, topping out at 19 wins in a single season (2016).
- Red Bull's rise has been dramatic: from single-digit wins through 2020 to 21 wins in 2023 alone.
- Mercedes had a rough patch in 2022-2023, winning only 1 race total across those two seasons.
- Ferrari has stayed competitive but has never led a season outright in this period; McLaren and three other teams picked up just a handful of wins combined.
